---
title: "Analog Loading"
format: html
---

## Overview

Analog time series stores continuous-valued samples over time (for example LFP, photometry, force sensors, motion energy).

Supported analog formats:

| Format | Typical Source | Available In |
|---|---|---|
| `csv` | Single-column or time/value table | Data Import Widget and JSON |
| `binary` | Raw interleaved channels | Data Import Widget (build-dependent) and JSON |
| `hdf5` | Time/value datasets in HDF5 | JSON workflows |

::: {.callout-note}
## JSON Data Type Name
Use `"data_type": "analog"` in JSON.
:::

## Data Import Widget

Open **Modules -> Data Import**, choose **Analog Time Series**.

### CSV mode

- Select file
- Choose delimiter
- Choose one-column or two-column layout
- If two-column, set time and data column indices

### Binary mode

- Select file
- Set `header_size`, `num_channels`, sample type, and scaling options
- Optional memory-mapped mode for large files

## JSON: CSV Analog (`format: "csv"`)

### Single-column CSV

```json
{
  "filepath": "ephys/lfp.csv",
  "data_type": "analog",
  "name": "lfp",
  "format": "csv",
  "single_column_format": true,
  "delimiter": ",",
  "has_header": false
}
```

### Two-column CSV (time + value)

```json
{
  "filepath": "ephys/lfp_time_value.csv",
  "data_type": "analog",
  "name": "lfp",
  "format": "csv",
  "single_column_format": false,
  "time_column": 0,
  "data_column": 1,
  "delimiter": ",",
  "has_header": true
}
```

| Element | Required? | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `single_column_format` | No | boolean | `true` | `true`: first column is value and row index is time |
| `delimiter` | No | string | `","` | Column delimiter |
| `has_header` | No | boolean | `false` | Skip first row when true |
| `time_column` | No | integer | `0` | Time column when `single_column_format` is `false` |
| `data_column` | No | integer | `1` | Value column when `single_column_format` is `false` |
| `clock` | No | string | `"time"` | Assigns this data to an existing TimeFrame |

## JSON: Binary Analog (`format: "binary"`)

```json
{
  "filepath": "ephys/amplifier.dat",
  "data_type": "analog",
  "name": "amplifier",
  "format": "binary",
  "header_size": 0,
  "num_channels": 32,
  "binary_data_type": "int16",
  "use_memory_mapped": true,
  "offset": 0,
  "stride": 1,
  "scale_factor": 1.0,
  "offset_value": 0.0,
  "num_samples": 0
}
```

| Element | Required? | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `header_size` | No | integer | `0` | Bytes to skip at file start |
| `num_channels` | No | integer | `1` | Interleaved channel count |
| `binary_data_type` | No | string | `"int16"` | One of: `int8`, `int16`, `uint16`, `float32`, `float64` |
| `use_memory_mapped` | No | boolean | `false` | Enables memory-mapped loading path |
| `offset` | No | integer | `0` | Starting element offset (memory-mapped path) |
| `stride` | No | integer | `1` | Sample stride (memory-mapped path) |
| `scale_factor` | No | number | `1.0` | Multiplicative sample scaling (memory-mapped path) |
| `offset_value` | No | number | `0.0` | Additive sample offset (memory-mapped path) |
| `num_samples` | No | integer | `0` | Max samples per channel (`0` means all) |

::: {.callout-tip}
When `num_channels > 1`, JSON batch loading creates one series per channel with names like `name_0`, `name_1`, and so on.
:::

## JSON: HDF5 Analog (`format: "hdf5"`)

```json
{
  "filepath": "ephys/signals.h5",
  "data_type": "analog",
  "name": "lfp",
  "format": "hdf5",
  "time_key": "time_s",
  "value_key": "lfp",
  "scale": 30000.0,
  "scale_divide": false
}
```

| Element | Required? | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `time_key` | Yes | string | - | Dataset path containing time values |
| `value_key` | Yes | string | - | Dataset path containing analog values |
| `scale` | No | number | `1.0` | Multiply (or divide) times before integer conversion |
| `scale_divide` | No | boolean | `false` | If true, divide by `scale` instead of multiply |
